source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: One idea I had was an instant quote calculator. It would allow clients to complete a form or quiz with questions about the services they want, and then calculate an estimated price in real time. I researched it, and it appears somewhat complicated. Is [PERSON_NAME_004] something you would be able to create?

value_updates.interaction_format: form or quiz about requested services
value_updates.quote_result: estimated price calculated in real time

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
[PERSON_NAME_003] you very much for the explanation. For the calculator, each of our services is itemized. The more services a customer selects, the more opportunities there are to bundle them. The calculator would therefore need to identify whether the selected services qualify for a bundle; otherwise, it would simply total the individual services. I imagine a survey format, potentially like the following:

What is the property's size in sqft? (under 1000 is pricing tier 1, 1001 - 2000 is pricing tier 2, 2001 - 3000 is pricing tier 3, 2001 - 3000 is pricing tier 4, and 3001 + is pricing tier 5; *answers 1253 sqft* is assigned to pricing tier 2)
Photos (yes/no): Yes = +200, No = +0 (*answers yes))*
*Videos? (yes/no):* Yes = +200, No = +0 (*answers yes))*
What is the address? (calculates the distance from the home office) (if it is over 25 miles, apply a $50 dollar surcharge) (*Answers address and is 28 miles away))) +50*
*(qualifies for basic bundle) -$100*
*(presses submit)*
*Displays total : $350*

value_updates.bundle_pricing_rule: determine whether selected services qualify for a bundle; otherwise total the individual service prices
value_updates.property_size_pricing: assign property square footage to a pricing tier
value_updates.service_add_on_logic: support yes-or-no itemized service selections that add to the quote
value_updates.distance_surcharge_rule: $50 surcharge when the property is more than 25 miles from the home office
value_updates.quote_submission_output: display the calculated total after submission

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: [PERSON_NAME_003] you very much. Also, regarding the instant quote form, I think we should postpone it for the time being. I will make sure to contact you again when we are ready to develop it.

routing_warnings.description: This message changes the static package display so it shows prices by square-footage range; it does not resume or modify the deferred instant quote calculator.
The implementation claim concerns revisions to the Pricing page rather than implementation of the instant quote calculator.
